name: ultron
description: Ultron — one-stop agentic cybersecurity plugin for Claude Code. Penetration testing (pentest) of local web apps and APIs, white-box source code security audit, and blue-team defense (DFIR incident response, log analysis, hardening). Covers OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, vulnerability detection, ethical hacking, red team and blue team workflows — evidence-backed, proof-first, scope-disciplined.
